name: Rental Kanojo
source:
Shogo lives alone, doing nothing every day. He has no job and lives a boring life. One day, he receives an ad paper for a newly opened shop. It seems the shop features rental girlfriends...? He immediately visits there and finds out that he can rent a girl for a certain period. He gets interested in it and joins them. His life with a rental girlfriend now begins...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081027105320/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008150]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
正吾独居，每天无所事事，没有工作，生活乏味。某天，他收到一家新开店铺的宣传单。店里似乎提供女友租赁服务……他立刻前往，得知可以在一定时间内租借一名女孩。他对此产生兴趣并加入其中。与租赁女友的生活由此开始……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081027105320/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008150]Eroge Shop[/url]]
